instrument_type: USDT-margined perpetual when discovery admits it
currencies: quote USDT; base is the contract base asset; multiplier is not stripped
raw_fields: kline[0] open ms, [1..4] OHLC, [5] base volume, [6] close ms, [7] quote volume, [8] trade count; [9]/[10] taker buy volumes remain inside raw_source only
native_unit: price in quote asset; volume in base asset; quote volume in quote asset
normalized_unit: CandleDTO decimals; taker buy volume is not a normalized field
conversion: none
timestamps: open and venue close are millisecond fields. Publication time is unavailable. Response time is not the candle time.
refresh: exchange candle cadence; cache TTL 60s is not a publication allowance
history: limit clamped at 1500; no unbounded pagination in the client
consumer: scanner candle fetch, essential freshness, technical structure, 2d resampler input when the source is 1d
missing_behavior: freshness missing or unverified; missing bars are not zero volume

currencies: linear USDT quote when the symbol is a USDT contract
raw_fields: list row start, OHLC, volume, turnover
native_unit: price in quote; volume in base; turnover in quote
normalized_unit: CandleDTO; close_timestamp left N/A and later derived as open plus duration
conversion: interval names mapped in _to_bybit_interval; 2d is not a native Bybit interval in that map
timestamps: start time is the open. No venue close field is copied. Newest-first rows are reversed only when strictly descending.
cache: same candle cache key family, exchange name bybit_linear
consumer: same candle consumers when the selected exchange is Bybit
role: required only on the Bybit exchange path
missing_behavior: integrity rejects unordered or gapped series; derived close is not a publication time
dev_exercised: existing Bybit normalizer tests where present; this phase checks envelope and OI separately

instrument_type: same contract as the daily source
normalized_unit: 2d OHLC; volume is the sum of the two daily volumes
conversion: open from first, close from second, high max, low min, volume sum
timestamps: bucket anchored at Unix epoch UTC. Incomplete pairs are omitted.
refresh: follows the daily source; a fresh 2d label is stale if a daily input is stale
history: only complete closed pairs at the decision cutoff
cache: cached as candles when the caller stores the result
role: required only when the configured interval is 2d
missing_behavior: incomplete pair emits nothing for that bucket
dev_exercised: existing timeframe tests; this phase checks volume conservation

parameters: symbol; Binance all-symbol call omits symbol
direct_or_aggregate: direct venue rolling window, not a closed candle
currencies: Binance quoteVolume is quote-asset turnover, not proven USD. Bybit turnover24h is the same class of quote turnover.
native_unit: USDT quote turnover when the contract quote is USDT
conversion: Binance priceChangePercent is divided by 100 into a ratio. USDT is not converted to USD.
timestamps: Binance uses ticker closeTime. Bybit copies response envelope time into TickerDTO.timestamp.
history: single rolling snapshot; not a fixed UTC day
consumer: universe quote-volume filter and scanner price
role: required for market-cap discovery liquidity intersection; optional as a mark source
missing_behavior: missing quote volume excludes the ticker row; it is not treated as zero

endpoint: Bybit tickers include markPrice and indexPrice. Binance 24h ticker normalizer does not set them. Funding history may carry markPrice.
normalized_unit: TickerDTO fields; Binance 24h path leaves mark and index at N/A
conversion: none; last, mark, and index are not interchangeable
timestamps: no dedicated mark publication time on the 24h ticker path
consumer: context and display; not a silent substitute for candle closes
missing_behavior: N/A on the DTO

currencies: rate is dimensionless; mark price is quote
raw_fields: fundingRate, funding time, markPrice when present
native_unit: fraction per settlement interval, not percent and not basis points
conversion: not divided or multiplied; 0.0001 fraction is 0.01 percent
timestamps: funding time is the settlement observation. Predicted next rate from premiumIndex is not requested. next funding time is N/A when absent.
history: Binance limit max 1000; Bybit limit max 200
consumer: ScannerRunner._fetch_optional_market_data then _derivatives_enrichment_input then _derivatives_rejection; REJECTED_BY_DERIVATIVES drops source timestamps. Shadow evidence is separate and cannot validate a confirmation.
missing_behavior: N/A funding context

parameters: symbol; Binance history period; Bybit intervalTime
currencies: unit is not stored; Binance history also has sumOpenInterestValue
raw_fields: openInterest or sumOpenInterest; Bybit singleOpenInterest is ignored
native_unit: Binance current openInterest is contracts in the official coin/contract convention for that symbol; history sumOpenInterest is the same family and sumOpenInterestValue is quote notional. Bybit unit is not proven here.
normalized_unit: OpenInterestDTO.open_interest with unit N/A; notional_value set from sumOpenInterestValue when present
conversion: enrichment percent change uses open_interest, not notional, so a pure price move is not position growth when both samples share a unit. The unit itself is not proven by the DTO.
timestamps: Binance time or timestamp ms; Bybit row timestamp ms. Snapshot versus interval history must not be mixed.
history: Binance history limit max 500; Bybit limit max 200
consumer: derivatives enrichment current_open_interest; legacy previous sample is history[-2]; timestamps are not copied onto those numbers. Shadow pairing is separate and cannot validate a confirmation.
missing_behavior: N/A; never zero
dev_exercised: this phase's both-field Bybit fixture and unit assertion

direct_or_aggregate: direct venue account population, not a position population
normalized_unit: Decimal returned directly, not a DTO
conversion: none; not equal to top-trader position ratio or taker flow
timestamps: row timestamp exists on the payload and is not retained by the Decimal return
consumer: optional derivatives input when the caller passes it
missing_behavior: caller-specific; a missing ratio must stay N/A

raw_fields: q, p, m; m true means the buyer is the maker so the seller is the aggressor
conversion: kline taker-buy indexes are not normalized
timestamps: trade time on the event; a quiet socket is not zero flow
history: in-memory only; no persisted tape in this phase
missing_behavior: disabled or stale is unavailable, not zero

currencies: price in quote, quantity in base
raw_fields: lastUpdateId, bids, asks, E, T; diff fields U, u, pu
normalized_unit: local book quantities; zero quantity deletes a level on the diff path
conversion: none
timestamps: snapshot E and T are required by the parser. Synchronization needs the diff sequence. Snapshot-only research is not_applicable for sync.
refresh: stale threshold default 5s; default feature flag false
missing_behavior: unverified or unavailable; a crossed book is not a valid sync
dev_exercised: existing order-book tests; this phase adds a crossed snapshot fixture

endpoint: forceOrder st=1; st=2 COIN-M is rejected
parameters: all-market stream filtered to tracked symbols
direct_or_aggregate: observed venue events, not a modelled heatmap
currencies: base quantity times average price for quote notional
raw_fields: o.S side, o.z filled quantity, o.ap average price, E, T
native_unit: base quantity; SELL means a long was liquidated
conversion: quote notional = accumulated filled quantity times average price
timestamps: event time and trade time. No REST liquidation history client.
refresh: stale threshold default 30s; default flag false
history: not retained as a complete venue history; gaps after reconnect are coverage gaps
missing_behavior: disconnected or gapped coverage is unavailable, not zero. A covered empty window on SymbolLiquidationAggregator reports event_count 0. liquidation_observation(None) is a separate helper and is not that aggregator.

provider: CCI from same-venue BTCUSDT candles plus optional funding and OI
conversion: technical structure agent; stale if the latest close is older than two intervals
timestamps: component time is the latest candle close, not the computation time
role: default enabled in Settings; runtime activation unverified
missing_behavior: component unavailable with a reason

parameters: bias timeframe, or 1d when bias is 2d
direct_or_aggregate: direct venue candles feeding a derived regime
conversion: none beyond the candle contract
timestamps: essential freshness role optional_regime; a regime computed from stale ETH candles is not fresh
role: optional; ScannerRunConfig.market_regime_enabled defaults false. There is no standalone ETH context service.
missing_behavior: ETHUSDT_candles: N/A
dev_exercised: regime tests construct eth candles directly

conversion: none
timestamps: last_updated is interpreted as Unix seconds. That is not a candle close and not an acquisition time.
refresh: cache TTL default 300s; fresh 600s; max stale 3600s. Stale fallback is labeled stale.
consumer: global context and regime btc_d_context when supplied
missing_behavior: context unavailable; not zero

parameters: btc and eth candles, optional dominance and breadth fields
venue: lineage is the candle venue plus CoinPaprika when BTC.D is attached
conversion: classifier; USDT.D defaults to N/A and is recorded missing
timestamps: decision_timestamp plus candle closes. Computation time does not refresh stale inputs.
missing_behavior: missing inputs are named N/A

direct_or_aggregate: derived from constituent candles and a static taxonomy
conversion: median constituent returns; minimum verified constituents default 3
timestamps: freshness is two intervals on the constituent series
consumer: apply_sector_context_to_symbol_result, which does not recalculate a trading decision
missing_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or UNCLASSIFIED; not a gate pass

code_refs.contains: without recalculating any trading decision field

direct_or_aggregate: provider market-cap methodology, then intersection with Binance USDT perpetual metadata
venue: rank is global; contract admission is Binance USD-M
instrument_type: PERPETUAL, TRADING, quote USDT, underlying COIN
contract_id: exchangeInfo symbol, including verified 1000-prefix mappings; the exchange price unit is not rescaled
currencies: CoinPaprika market cap is USD methodology. Binance quote volume is USDT turnover. They are not equated.
native_unit: USD market cap in the provider methodology; raw rank integer
normalized_unit: SymbolUniverse raw rank map plus qualified_rank diagnostics
conversion: qualified_rank after reviewed genuine classification and non-genuine exclusions. An unclassified identity inside the cohort window fails closed. Ambiguous tickers without a verified provider id are excluded. Qualified rank above the cohort is not refilled.
timestamps: provider payload does not become a candle time. generated_at is acquisition time.
refresh: each universe resolution; no rank cache on the strict path (cache_used false)
cache: not used for the strict ranking path
consumer: discovery symbol list. Active owners are a separate monitoring set.
missing_behavior: universe resolution error; discovery failure does not stop owner monitoring

endpoint: BLS ICS, Fed calendar HTML, BEA release_dates.json
conversion: US Eastern schedule normalized to UTC
timestamps: source schedule time and fetched_at. Vintage revision semantics are only as complete as the parsed page.
refresh: cache TTL default 6 hours; max stale 48 hours
role: default macro_event_context_enabled true; runtime unverified. Not a setup-generation authority.
missing_behavior: source status unavailable or unverified

conversion: required close E = anchor + floor((D - allowance - anchor) / delta) * delta; allowance is zero
timestamps: scheduled close is open plus duration. Cache TTL is not an allowance. Unix epoch UTC anchor, including synthetic 2d.
history: latest closed candle must cover E
missing_behavior: stale or missing blocks new confirmation; owner preservation is a separate rule

endpoint: canonical public setup-quality decision and public RR
parameters: evaluated setup quality score and grade; planned RR
conversion: none
timestamps: n/a
missing_behavior: unevaluated quality is not a pass
dev_exercised: public signal quality tests; this phase reasserts the constants

conversion: next start is scheduled start plus N intervals, not a sleep appended after completion
timestamps: monotonic clock
role: operational; this phase does not start it
missing_behavior: n/a
